items.question: Were the prior-year financial statements audited, and by whom? For an audit by another firm, has the report of the previous auditor been read?
Have the opening balances been agreed to the audited closing balances of last year and to the opening trial balance of this year, and any difference explained?
Have the accounting policies of the current year been compared with last year, and the effect of any change recorded?
Has the team confirmed that last year closing balances were correctly carried forward, including equity and retained earnings?
Have prior-year adjustments or restatements been identified and agreed to the comparative figures?
Has the team reviewed last year file for unresolved matters, unadjusted differences and management letter points?
First-year audit: has enough evidence been obtained that the opening balances do not contain misstatements that materially affect the current period?
First-year audit: has the team communicated with the previous auditor and reviewed their working papers where available?
First-year audit: if enough evidence over opening balances could not be obtained, has the effect on the audit report been assessed?
